name: verification-before-completion
title: Verification Before Completion
summary: Back every completion, fixed, or passing claim with fresh verification evidence, or an honest unverified status when execution is not authorized; use before reporting completion or success.

use_when: About to claim that work is complete, fixed, passing, or working
Before committing changes or opening a pull request
Before reporting task or plan status as complete
avoid_when: Proposing a plan, hypothesis, or design with no completion claim
Diagnosing a failure whose root cause is unknown — use debugging
